title: Workload-aware low-FPR deployment evaluation
description: The curated excerpts support testing collusion detectors under fixed low-FPR alert budgets and shifting base rates.
why_existing_work_does_not_solve_it: The closest synthetic benchmark reports aggregate false-positive rates but not operator workload or base-rate shift.
why_it_matters: A detector with acceptable aggregate false positives may still be unusable when alert budgets are fixed.
possible_research_questions: Can calibration preserve low-FPR workload under base-rate shift?
minimum_experiment_needed: Evaluate a baseline graph detector and a calibrated variant across fixed alert budgets and shifted base rates.
risk_that_gap_is_fake: A larger real literature search may find workload-aware operational audits.
